# Font-weight fixtures

[简体中文](README.zh.md)

These original Reel TrueType inputs share the "Reel Weight Fixture" typographic
family. Each contains .notdef, space and a rectangular A glyph. Weights
400/600/700 use A advances of 500/650/800 units and stem widths of 100/180/260 at
1000 units per em. FontTools 4.60.1 FontBuilder serialized the fonts. The outlines
and naming data are distributed under the workspace license.
